# Invoice checker

Checks electronic invoices for required fields and tax totals.

## Install

Copy `invoice-checker` into `~/.claude/skills/`.

# Invoice Checker

## Steps
1. Read the invoice.
2. Check totals and VAT.
3. List missing fields.
